text: Based on the output from the evidence tools, we can certify that no fire occurred on the asset during the period from October 6, 2026, to November 5, 2026. The data from NASA FIRMS, which includes detections from VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS, shows zero detections intersecting the asset. All sensors covered the entire period, ensuring comprehensive monitoring. Therefore, there is no evidence of fire activity on the asset during the specified timeframe.
